portals.name: Udaipur official registry / cadastral map sources
portals.operator: Official city, regional or national public authority, as described per source
portals.observation: Udaipur Development Authority publishes city property and planning services. The Rajasthan E-Mapping viewer uses khasra/village boundaries and displays Khasra ID, DLC rates and coordinates for a selected record; no selector was submitted and no parcel was clicked. Static UDA plan documents are planning/layout products, not a verified current parcel feature service. No safe geometry-only public route was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official Udaipur Development Authority offers city-specific Property ID, property name-transfer, mutation, subdivision, and land-layout services. Rajasthan’s state E-Mapping portal shows urban khasra selection and explicitly exposes a Khasra ID and land-rate information, so it is not a safe geometry-only response. These sources establish city development/property administration, but not open parcel coverage at this point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public geometry-only parcel response was verified.

technicalBlocker: The accessible cadastral map workflow is selection-based and returns parcel identifiers/rates; no server-side allowlist for geometry-only data was exposed. The UDA GIS zonal-plan product is not verified parcel geometry.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separate public UDA cadastral feature service exposes geometry without khasra identifiers or property/tax data.
nextStep: If parcel geometry is needed, verify a distinct official public geometry-only feature service with a server-side allowlist before any point request.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
